title: Library loaded from a search path (c)
description: The code loads a shared object with dlopen and a name that is not an absolute path. The loader then searches relative directories, so a library planted next to the working directory is loaded instead of the intended one. This lexical rule flags the load; the reviewer checks the path.
remediation: Load with an absolute, packaged path, for example dlopen with an absolute packaged path.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the load without resolving the path at runtime.
